# What EpiExposure does?

`EpiExposure`...

```{r}
sim_data = readxl::read_xlsx("sim_data.xlsx")
```
```{r}
head(sim_data)
```


```{r}
wetness_plot = sim_data%>% 
  ggplot(aes(time,wetness, group = epi_id))+
  geom_smooth(se = F, color = "#55A868",linewidth = 0.3)+
```

```{r}

sim_data2 = sim_data |> 
  filter(epi_id <= 480)

sim_data3 = sim_data |> 
  filter(!epi_id <= 480)

sim_data2$epi_id = as.factor(sim_data2$epi_id)
sim_data3$epi_id = as.factor(sim_data3$epi_id)

### train

cb <- define_exposure(
  data = sim_data2,
  vars = c("wetness","tmean","rain"),
  lag_max = 85,
  df_var = 3,
  df_lag = 2
)

dat <- build_design(
  data = sim_data2,
  cb_templates = cb,
  lag_max = 85
)

dat <- prepare_response(data = dat, y_var = "y", family = "beta")

fit <- fit_epidlnm(
  data = dat,
  model_engine = "glmmTMB",
  family = "beta",
  random_effect = NULL,
  epiexposure_spec = attr(cb, "spec")
)
summary(fit)

fit$sdr$pdHess
range(dat$y_model)
sum(dat$y_model <= 0)

sum(dat$y_model >= 1)

any(is.na(vcov(fit)$cond))


###  test

cb2 <- define_exposure(
  data = sim_data3,
  vars = c("wetness","tmean","rain"),
  lag_max = 85,
  df_var = 3,
  df_lag = 2
)

dat2 <- build_design(
  data = sim_data3,
  cb_templates = cb,
  lag_max = 85
)

dat2 <- prepare_response(data = dat2, y_var = "y", family = "beta")


summary(fit)

t = predict(fit, newdata = dat2, type = "response",allow.new.levels=TRUE)


dat3 = dat2
dat3$t = t


dat3 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y,t))+
  geom_point(color = "#C44E52", size = 2)+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F, color = "#55A868", linewidth = 1.4)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Observed (proportion)",
       y = "Predicted (proportion)")+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,0.80), expand = c(0.01,0.01))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,0.80), expand = c(0.01,0.01))



```


```{r}
library(DescTools)
CCC(dat3$y, dat3$t, ci = "z-transform", conf.level = 0.95, na.rm = FALSE)
```

```{r}
check_identifiability(data = sim_data, var = "tmean",
                      df_var = 4, df_lag = 2, lag_max = 85)

```

# Effect summarization

## Lag-specific
```{r}
#surface = predict_surface(fit = fit, wx_long = sim_data, var = "tmean", lag_max = 85,
 #                   uncertainty = TRUE, output = "summary", n_samples = 10)

epi_l = summarise_effects(fit = fit, data = sim_data,
                  scale = "daily", effect_measure = "percent",
                  uncertainty = TRUE, n_samples = 20,
                  output = "summary",
                  at = list (
                    tmean = seq(15,35, length.out = 1000),
                    rain = seq(0,15, length.out = 1000),
                    wetness = seq(0,24, length.out = 1000)))

epi_l
```

```{r}
epi_l |> 
  filter(var == "tmean") |> 
  filter(lag == 1) |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_smooth(aes(value,effect), color = "#4C72B0", se = F)+
  geom_smooth(aes(value,effect_lower), color = "#4C72B0", se = F, linetype = 2)+
  geom_smooth(aes(value,effect_upper), color = "#4C72B0", se = F, linetype = 2)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Exposure (mm)",
       y = "Effect")
```

```{r}


epi_plot <- epi_l %>%
  filter(var == "tmean")


lims <- quantile(
  epi_plot$effect,
  probs = c(0.02, 0.98),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

max_abs <- max(abs(lims))

epi_plot <- epi_plot %>%
  mutate(
    effect_c = pmax(
      pmin(effect, max_abs),
      -max_abs
    )
  )

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(metR)
library(grid)

tmean_contour <- ggplot(
  epi_plot,
  aes(
    x = lag,
    y = value
  )
) +

  geom_raster(
    aes(fill = effect_c),
    interpolate = TRUE
  ) +

  geom_contour(
    aes(z = effect),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.25,
    breaks = c(-15, -10, -5, 0, 5, 10, 15)
  ) +

  geom_text_contour(
    aes(z = effect),
    breaks = 0,
    stroke = 0.15,
    #label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"),
    size = 3.2
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3B4CC0", 
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B40426",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-max_abs, max_abs),
    oob = squish,
    name = "RR (%)",
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth  = unit(4, "cm"),
      barheight = unit(0.5, "cm")
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_reverse(
    breaks = pretty(epi_plot$lag, n = 8),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = pretty(epi_plot$value, n = 6),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Lag",
    y = "Mean temperature (°C)"
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

tmean_contour
```

```{r}

epi_p11 <- epi_p1 |>
  mutate(
    period = factor(
      period,
      levels = c("Period4", "Period3", "Period2","Period1")
    ),
    var = factor(
      var,
      levels = c("tmean", "rain", "wetness")
    )
  )

epi_p11 |>
  filter(sample != 10) |>
  ggplot(aes(value, eta, group = sample, color = sample)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(var ~ period, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Exposure",
    y = "Response")

ggsave("phase_effect.png",dpi = 600, width = 8, height = 6)

```


# ECI

## Overall

```{r}
ct = compute_eci(
  data = sim_data,
  group = "epi_id",
  group_level = NULL,
  fit = fit,
  var = c("tmean", "rain", "wetness"),
  scale = "response",
  uncertainty = TRUE, n_samples = 10,
                  output = "summary"
)


ctt = ct |> 
  filter(var == "rain")




sim_datact = sim_data |> 
  group_by(epi_id) |> 
  summarise(y = mean(y))


ctt$y = sim_datact$y

cor.test(ctt$ECI_weighted, ctt$y,
         method = "spearman")

ctt |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(ECI_weighted,y))+
  geom_smooth(aes(ECI_weighted,y),se = F)+
  geom_smooth(aes(lower,y),se = F)+
  geom_smooth(aes(upper,y),se = F)

ctt2 = ctt |> 
mutate(pressure = case_when(y > 0.24 ~ "High severity",
                           y <= 0.24 ~"Low severity")) 

ctt2 |>
  ggplot(aes(ECI_weighted))+
  geom_histogram(color = "white", fill = "steelblue", bins = 10)+
  facet_wrap(~pressure)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"))

ctt2 |> 
 # filter(pressure == "High severity") |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(ECI_weighted,y))+
  geom_smooth(aes(ECI_weighted,y),se = F)+
  geom_smooth(aes(lower,y),se = F)+
  geom_smooth(aes(upper,y),se = F)+
  facet_wrap(~pressure)

median(ctt$y)
```

## Lag
```{r}
ct2  = compute_ecilag(
  data = sim_data,
  group = "epi_id",
  fit = fit,
  group_level = 1,
  var = c("tmean", "rain","wetness"),
  uncertainty = FALSE,
  n_samples = 10,
 output = "summary")

ct3 = ct2$by_lag

ct3 |> 
  filter(var == "rain") |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_smooth(aes(exposure,abs_contribution), se = F)+
  geom_smooth(aes(exposure,abs_contribution_upper), se = F, linetype = 2)+
  geom_smooth(aes(exposure,abs_contribution_lower), se = F, linetype = 2)+
  theme_bw()
  
ct_tmean = ct3 %>% 
  filter(var == "rain")

datt = sim_data |> 
  filter(epi_id == 1)

ct_tmean$sev = datt$y


ct_tmean %>% 
  #filter(lag == 85) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(ECI_weighted))+
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, color = "white")




cor.test(ct_tmean$exposure, ct_tmean$percent_contribution,
         method = "spearman")


ct_tmean |> 
  ggplot(aes(exposure,percent_contribution))+
  geom_point()
```

# Simulations and outcome predictions

## Scenario 01

```{r}
exposure_tmean_01 <- simulate_exposure(lag_max = 85,
                  mode = "profile", seed = 123,
                  #pattern = "alternating_times",
                  #alternating_values = c(20,24),
                  #background = list(dist = "normal", mean = 25, sd = 10),
                  background = list(dist = "ar1", mean = 25, sd = 4, phi = 0.90),
                  n = 1)

exposure_rain_01 <- simulate_exposure(lag_max = 85,
                  mode = "pattern", seed = 123,
                  pattern = "block_times",
                  block_times = c(0,40),
                  fixed_value = 15,
                  background = list(dist = "fixed", value = 0),
                  n = 1)

exposure_wetness_01 <- simulate_exposure(lag_max = 85,
                  mode = "profile", seed = 123,
                  #alternating_values = c(5,15),
                  background = list(dist = "AR1", mean = 15, sd = 4, phi = 0.10),
                  n = 1)

#head(exposure_tmean$profiles)
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)

  exposure_tmean_01$profile,
  ~ tibble(
      simulation = .y,
      time = 0:85,
      value = as.numeric(.x)
    )
)



df_tmean_01 <- data.frame(
  time = 0:85,
  value = as.numeric(exposure_tmean_01$profile)
)

plot_tmean_simu_01  = df_tmean_01%>% 
  ggplot(aes(time,value))+
  #geom_smooth(se = F, color = "#4C72B0",linewidth = 1.4)+
  geom_line(color = "#C44E52", size = 1.4)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Time",
       y = "Exposure")+
  scale_x_continuous(
  limits = c(0, 85),
  breaks = seq(0, 85, by = 10)
)+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
```
